server_name.label: Server Name
server_name.description: Name of the Loxone AudioServer as shown in Loxone Config and the Loxone App.

listen_ip.label: Bind IP Address
listen_ip.description: IP address to bind the Loxone HTTP/WebSocket listeners to (0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

app_http_port.label: Loxone App Port (TCP)
app_http_port.description: Port used for Loxone App HTTP requests and WebSockets (default: 7091).

ms_http_port.label: Loxone Miniserver Port (TCP)
ms_http_port.description: Port used for Miniserver HTTP requests and WebSockets (default: 7095).

udp_discovery_port.label: Discovery UDP Port
udp_discovery_port.description: Port used for Loxone UDP broadcast discovery (default: 7070).

mac_address.label: MAC Address
mac_address.description: Custom MAC address for the emulated AudioServer (leave empty to generate automatically).
